mapper.select: select o.member_id memberId, oi.order_id orderId, oi.product_id productId, coalesce(oi.product_quantity, 1) quantity, oi.product_category_id productCategoryId, oi.product_brand productBrand, o.create_time createTime from oms_order o inner join oms_order_item oi on o.id = oi.order_id where o.delete_status = 0 and o.status in (1, 2, 3) and oi.product_id is not null order by o.create_time desc

select o.id id, o.member_id memberId, o.order_sn orderSn, o.create_time createTime, o.member_username memberUsername, o.total_amount totalAmount, o.pay_amount payAmount, o.status status, o.source_type sourceType, o.order_type orderType, o.receiver_phone receiverPhone from oms_order o where o.delete_status = 0 and o.create_time is not null and o.create_time >= date_sub( (select max(o2.create_time) from oms_order o2 where o2.delete_status = 0 and o2.create_time is not null), interval #{days} day ) order by o.create_time desc
select max(o.create_time) from oms_order o where o.delete_status = 0 and o.create_time is not null
